purpose: Characterize host wall time inside synchronization calls in an earlier traced run; not a CPU utilization or throughput measurement.

input.capture: Nsight Systems CUDA software trace; CPU sampling and context-switch collection disabled

query: SELECT r.start, r.end, r.globalTid FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r JOIN StringIds s ON r.nameId = s.id WHERE s.value = 'cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020' ORDER BY r.start
limitations: CUDA tracing changes execution timing; these values are not an uninstrumented performance result.
Call duration is host wall time inside the runtime call, not CPU compute or utilization.
The trace has no CPU sampling or CUDA call stacks and does not identify the source or removability of these waits.
A single short synthetic request does not qualify long-context behavior.
